recipe.title: Vanilla Berry Protein Waffle Bowl
recipe.summary: Creamy vanilla protein yogurt topped with fresh strawberries and served with two warm protein waffles on the side.
recipe.story: This is the kind of breakfast that feels fun without requiring any real cooking. The protein powder turns the yogurt into a thicker vanilla dip, and the two warm protein waffles make it easy to scoop and dip.
ingredients: 1 cup Oikos Triple Zero Vanilla Greek Yogurt
1/2 scoop Clean Simple Eats Simply Vanilla Protein Powder
instructions: Toast the waffles according to package directions.
Stir the protein powder into the Greek yogurt until smooth and creamy.
Top the yogurt with the sliced strawberries.
Serve the two warm whole waffles alongside the yogurt bowl for dipping.
tips: Serve the waffles whole beside the yogurt bowl for a simple, realistic one-serving presentation.
Nutrition is approximate and may vary by yogurt and protein powder formulation.
